notes: : subjective steering removed. No Cu flagship batch, no modality quotas, no Disease_Intervention/Mechanism mandates, no element preferences. 4 batches x 25 free-composition candidates; the model distributes modalities and mechanisms at its own discretion. Verifiability requirements kept (real names, no invented SMILES/UniProt). Pre-Phase-4 steered nano-only config (pipeline_config.nano_only.json) deleted — its purpose was reproducing the Cu-steered baseline, which no longer exists.
toa_goal: Predict 100 drug candidates for Alzheimer's disease therapy, spanning nano formulations, biologics, small molecules, and other innovative approaches — freely distributed across all types with NO element or modality quotas. Classify every candidate along four dimensions: drug type, target category, action mode, and AD therapeutic mechanism. Assess delivery efficiency, multi-target synergy, effect durability, manufacturability, and biosafety; analyze mechanisms; produce a ranked summary report.

batches.focus: diverse AD drug candidates across all drug types (nano_formulation, small_molecule, biologic, other) with no modality or element quota. Each candidate must be a DISTINCT base therapeutic (no size/core/form variants of one parent). Names must be real and verifiable where applicable; SMILES/UniProt only when completely certain, else NA
